cues.zh: 你知道不能总让自己这么消沉
cues.en: Y'know you can't keep letting it get you down

cues.zh: 也不能总背着包袱不放
cues.en: And you can't keep dragging dead weight around
If there ain't all that much to lug around,
Better run like hell when you hit the ground.

cues.zh: 你挡不住这些孩子们跳舞
cues.en: You can't stop these kids from dancing

cues.zh: 尤其是当你自己已经心满意足？

cues.zh: 要是你思想僵化、腿脚不灵，
cues.en: 'Cause if your mind don't move and your knees don't bend,

cues.zh: 就别再去怪那些年轻人。
cues.en: well don't go blaming the kids again.
